coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across multiple angles: (1) Official product documentation and UI guides for all five bundled graph UIs (Neo4j Browser, Memgraph Lab, TigerGraph GraphStudio, NebulaGraph Studio, PuppyGraph); (2) Market sizing and growth data from 8+ analyst firms (market-and-markets, Gartner, Forrester references via industry sources); (3) Competitive comparison sources including G2, Capterra, DB Engines, and Gartner Peer Insights; (4) GitHub activity and community signals; (5) HCI research on visualization and query builders from CHI, UIST, arXiv, and academic venues; (6) Funding and investor data from PitchBook, Crunchbase, CB Insights; (7) Pricing and feature pages from official sources; (8) Integration ecosystem (Kafka, Spark, cloud platforms); (9) Standards work (GQL/ISO 39075, openCypher); (10) Practitioner resources and case studies. Deduplication performed on market research (consolidated variant CAGR estimates into T0 reports). Named authorities: Ben Shneiderman, Tamara Munzner, Cambridge Intelligence, Graphistry. Notable gaps deferred: detailed UX personas from proprietary Gartner reports (paywalled), closed-source usability test data, internal design system documentation not published online. All sources verified to be real, accessible URLs.
